name: pixel-char-splitter
description: 逐字符随机顺序文字揭示工具
interaction: Characters render one-by-one in randomized sequence, each exploding from scattered pixels into cohesive glyphs with staggered timing. Hover or click any revealed character to trigger a re-scramble ripple that cascades outward to neighbors. The final reassembly delivers a satisfying snap-to-read moment as all pieces lock into place.
